gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subjects with suspected infiltrating glioma on pre-operative brain imaging scans including non-enhancing MRI tumor components

coder_notes: Device-only focused-ultrasound BBB disruption study in suspected infiltrating glioma (non-enhancing tumour); glioblastoma appears only in keywords, which does not count. Definity (microbubbles) and gadolinium are referred to only in exclusion criteria and are not registered interventions, so not listed as agents (R9).
